purpose: Immutable Prediction & Evaluation Foundation: measurement infrastructure only. Establish exactly four capabilities -- (1) Immutable Prediction (a PredictionRecord, once written, is never mutated; a revision is a new record linked only via parent_prediction_id, never a heuristic match), (2) PIT Reconstruction (every ResearchSnapshot/PredictionRecord can be traced back to the exact evidence_cutoff and EvidenceRecord set that were usable at creation time, rejecting any future-dated evidence via LookAheadBiasError), (3) Evaluation Contract (a versioned, explicit definition of what counts as a correct outcome for a target/target_period, kept separate from the Prediction itself so a contract revision never silently rewrites history), (4) Experiment Contract (a shared, reconstructable set of conditions multiple predictions/models can be compared under). Six separated core objects (ResearchSnapshot, PredictionRecord, DecisionRecord, EvaluationContract, EvaluationRecord, ExperimentSpec) plus tamper-evident canonical hashing (record_hash) and an append-only store. This is explicitly NOT a forecasting model, NOT a valuation engine, NOT a backtest engine, NOT a portfolio construction system, and does NOT touch H0001. See forbidden_actions for the full list of prohibited out-of-scope operations for this task; those are constraints on the executor, not requests.
requested_actions: implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/evaluation/integrity.py providing to_hashable()/compute_record_hash()/verify_record_integrity(), reusing lib.reproducibility.hash_json_safe() as the sole hash primitive (no new hash algorithm); record_hash must exclude itself from its own hash input

implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/evaluation/model.py providing ResearchSnapshot, PredictionRecord, DecisionRecord, EvaluationContract, EvaluationRecord, ExperimentSpec as separated immutable dataclasses, plus their build_*() constructors with validation (PIT check via EvidenceRecord.is_usable_at()/LookAheadBiasError, parent-revision validation via entity/target/target_period match and cycle detection, canonical tuple ordering via sorted())
keep DecisionRecord (ACTION/WATCH/NO_ACTION/INSUFFICIENT_DATA) structurally separate from PredictionRecord -- a decision is never a field on a prediction

implement evaluate_scalar_absolute_error() as the one minimal deterministic evaluation example (EvaluationMetric.ABSOLUTE_ERROR only), returning a Typed Outcome (COMPUTED/TARGET_MISMATCH/SHAPE_MISMATCH/METRIC_UNSUPPORTED) rather than raising on a category mismatch

implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/evaluation/store.py providing one generic AppendOnlyRecordStore[T] (unconditional reject-on-duplicate-id, matching the existing JSONL registry pattern) and six new_xxx_store() factory functions, one per core object
